source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole board (board_source.py / board.json rule)
activation_note: INERT until LAS-160 approves a reservation program. Links render plain with first-party UTM (utm_campaign=EXP-0103); no affiliate id is applied while every network in affiliate_config.json is disabled with a placeholder id. Flipping a network enabled=true with a real id there (or via its env var) activates the affiliate wrap on this rail with no code change. Caveat: an Eventbrite listing that already carries its own aff= search tag will not be overridden by our Eventbrite id (affiliate._add_params never clobbers an existing param); resolving that is an LAS-160 activation decision.
methodology: A window is listed only when its own crawl-captured link (booking_url, else source_url) lands on a recognised reservation/ticket platform, the crawl verified it (not needs_confirm), and it carries a real parseable close date that has not passed. No dead or invented links; an empty week is honest. Sorted soonest-closing first.
